name: Switch 4 lines - Premium 2.0 - $5/mo off per new line
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: busy dad, direct.
scripted_messages: Hi, I'm moving my family of four from T-Mobile and I need to know what four lines on Premium 2.0 would cost. I saw an extra $5 off per month for 12 months on each new line when you have four or more lines, and the AutoPay discount. What would the monthly total look like with both?
Thanks. So $50 per line for four lines, before the discounts?
And does the AutoPay discount need a bank account or does a debit card work too?
What would our first bill look like with the activation fees and taxes?
That's a big saving compared to what we pay now. Thank you so much, you were great and very patient with a busy dad.
That's all, have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
